title: Pho Thin 13 Lo Duc | Tyler Cowen's Ethnic Dining Guide
contentHtml:
Pho Thin, 13 Lo Duc, web site, 7263H Arlington Blvd., Falls Church, VA, Graham Park Plaza, (571) 746-8446 (Metro Trip Planner – opens in new window) [Google | Washingtonian | Reddit]

Has there been anything new in the Pho arena for…decades now? Well, this is it. Northern style Pho, only a few dishes on the menu. Better quality beef than anywhere else, thicker noodles, fragrant broth. Maybe my favorite Pho right now? Note that a bowl will cost you slightly more than $20, in other words more than a burrito!

A nice place to sit, recommended.
